title: Demystifying AI: A Beginner's Guide to Building Your First Neural Network with Keras
summary:
How to build a simple AI model using Python and Keras. It covers importing necessary libraries, loading
                and preparing the Iris dataset, one-hot encoding labels, and splitting the data into training and test
                sets. It then guides you through creating a sequential neural network, compiling the model, training it,
                evaluating its performance, and making predictions. The tutorial highlights that with modern libraries
                like Keras, developing AI models is accessible and straightforward for beginners.
excerpt: Build a first neural network with Python and Keras. A practical walkthrough of preparing data, training a model, and making predictions with the Iris dataset.

title: Persistence is All I Need
summary:
Developing a trading bot, progressing from basic AI concepts to advanced applications in financial
                    analytics. Despite challenges, they experiment with various techniques and models, demonstrating a
                    journey of learning, adaptation, and persistent exploration in AI.

title: Unlocking the Universe: Why Understanding Complexity Isn't Just Smart, It's Essential
summary:
Explore the importance of understanding complexity in various fields, showing how simple rules can
                    create complex systems. It covers concepts like self-organization, emergent behavior, and the
                    balance between chaos and order, emphasizing their relevance in decision-making and technology.

title: Digital Darwinism: The Inevitable Evolution and Ethics of AI Life
summary:
Explores the inevitable evolution of autonomous AI into complex, possibly sentient beings. Delves
                    into the ethical considerations of interacting with these entities, balancing concerns with an
                    optimistic vision of collaboration and mutual respect. Concludes with a call for empathy,
                    understanding, and a synthesis of human and AI ethics to forge a harmonious future.
excerpt: What might happen as autonomous AI becomes more complex? Thoughts on artificial life, ethics, and how humans might relate to it.

title: Bitcoin: A Prototype for Future Governance
summary:
Web3 technologies and cryptocurrencies offer trustless, transparent, and permissionless systems that
                    have the potential to revolutionize governance and the future of money.

title: Passwords without Managers
summary:
Navigating the labyrinth of password creation can seem daunting. This guide provides a balanced
                    approach, advocating the use of password formulas to generate unique, memorable, and secure
                    passwords for every site you use. By concocting your own recipe, you can create a strong password
                    that meets each site's requirements and keep it fresh with simple annual updates. It's a 'set and
                    forget' method that replaces the need for sticky notes or repetitive passwords and offers a smart
                    solution to modern password dilemmas.
excerpt: An experiment in memorable passwords: creating a personal formula and adapting it for different sites. The approach, the reasoning, and the tradeoffs.

title: My First Crypto Arbitrage Bot
summary: Documentation of my first attempt at a crypto arbitrage bot.

title: Building the SolidVote Decentralized Voting Application
summary:
I discuss creating SolidVote, a decentralized voting app on Ethereum. The journey involved smart
                    contracts, Truffle, Ganache, web3.js, Node.js, and Metamask integration, leading to a functional and
                    secure voting application.

title: Welcome to the Pantech Phone Server
summary:
My experience setting up my first local server using Tiny Server. Outlines roadmap for learning web servers
			and programming, including my goal of pursuing Ethereum-based smart contract programming. The post also
			provides instructions for setting up SSH access and authorized keys for passwordless login.
excerpt: Turning an old phone into my first web server. Notes on Tiny Server, SSH access, and the beginnings of a programming journey.

title: My Journey Setting Up a LAMP Server on an HP Mini
summary:
Reviving my HP Mini with Lubuntu, I share my journey of setting up a LAMP server. Despite hardware
			limitations and resolution challenges, I find solutions to wifi and video issues. Join me as I breathe new
			life into this old machine for web server experimentation.
